title: eng-platform
text:
eng-platform

alex: quick async check on obs console items — I want one-line statuses from owners so I can update the sprint board. scope: dashboard panels, tracing hooks, error-analysis views, retention milestone. please call out blockers and ETA (staging -> prod).

priya: dashboards — panel PR open: https://git.internal/r/redwood/console/pulls/842. waiting on metrics rename from backend team (they're rolling a small schema change). target staging deploy Fri EOD if rename lands. blocker: backend needs a migration window.

drew: tracing hooks — PR merged to staging, canary enabled at 10% for cpu-bound endpoints. sampling still defaults to 1% which is too low for the new traces; need infra help to bump sampling to 5% in staging config. also filed a follow-up to add trace tags for request_type.

sam: retention policy — propose increasing trace retention for 90-day evaluation window, current snippet below. worried about cost increase; need a rough cost delta from finance before we commit.

``` 
retention:
  traces_days: 90
  metrics_days: 30
  logs_days: 14
```

maria: error-analysis views — created queries for exception grouping and slow-path detection, pushed dashboard prototypes to the branch priya referenced. still need synthetic error events to validate group-by behavior. @sasha can you coordinate QA scenarios?

sasha: yep — I'll schedule a short test run tomorrow and post scenarios. also will run the feature toggle matrix so we validate canary paths.

deploy-bot: canary rollout started for pr/842 -> staging (10% traffic). link: https://deploys.internal/r/redwood/console/deploys/5678 :rocket:

alex: thanks all. ownership summary for my board update: dashboards = priya (blocked by backend rename), tracing hooks = drew (needs infra sampling bump), error-analysis = maria (needs QA scenarios from sasha), retention decision = sam (waiting on cost delta). request: owners please drop final ETA here by EOD tomorrow. if any blocker can't be unblocked, call it out and i'll escalate. :white_check_mark:
